```{r, results="hide", echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE)
if (!exists(".version")) {
    .version <- package_version("1.0")
}
```

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("# Ranged summarized experiment (", as.character(.version), ")", sep="")
```

## Overview

The `ranged_summarized_experiment` specification describes an on-disk representation of a _ranged summarized experiment_. 
This is a _summarized experiment_ that also stores the genomic location corresponding to each row.
It is based on the `RangedSummarizedExperiment` class from the [**SummarizedExperiment** Bioconductor package](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SummarizedExperiment).

The `ranged_summarized_experiment` specification is derived from the [`summarized_experiment` specification](../summarized_experiment).
A _ranged summarized experiment_ can be used anywhere that a _summarized experiment_ is expected.

## Object metadata

The `OBJECT` file should contain a `ranged_summarized_experiment` property, which is itself a JSON object with the following properties:

- `version`, a string specifying the version of the `ranged_summarized_experiment` format.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("  This should be set to \"", as.character(.version), "\".", sep="")
```

In addition, the `OBJECT` file should contain all properties expected of the [`summarized_experiment`](../summarized_experiment) format. 

## Directory structure

### Contents

The directory should contain:

- `OBJECT`, a JSON file as described above.
- All files expected of the [`summarized_experiment`](../summarized_experiment) format.

Optionally, it may contain:

- `row_ranges/`, a subdirectory.
- Any of the files that may be present in the [`summarized_experiment`](../summarized_experiment) format.

### `row_ranges/`

The `row_ranges/` should contain a child object that is a [`genomic_ranges`](../genomic_ranges) or a [`genomic_ranges_list`](../genomic_ranges_list).
The height of the child object should be equal to the number of rows in the _ranged summarized experiment_ (see ["Dimensions"](#dimensions) below).
The $i$-th entry of the child object contains the genomic coordinates of the $i$-th row of the _ranged summarized experiment_.

Note that any names in the `row_ranges/` child object should not be used as the row names of the _ranged summarized experiment_.
The row names are instead taken from the `row_data/` of the `summarized_experiment` specification.
This represents a minor deviation from the default implementation of the Bioconductor package.

If `row_ranges/` is not present, it is assumed that the _ranged summarized experiment_ has no genomic coordinates.
This is typically represented by a [_genomic ranges list_](../genomic_ranges_list) of length equal to the number of rows,
where each list element is an empty _genomic ranges_ object.

## Height

The height of a _ranged summarized experiment_ is defined in the same manner as its base [_summarized experiment_](../summarized_experiment).

## Dimensions

The dimensions of a _ranged summarized experiment_ are defined in the same manner as its base [_summarized experiment_](../summarized_experiment).

## Interfaces

A _ranged summarized experiment_ satisfies the `SUMMARIZED_EXPERIMENT` interface.
